title: UneceEmission
description:
A calculation of the pollution (including noise, heat, and radiation etc.) discharged into the environment by a
residential, commercial, or industrial facility or by a means of transport, such as a vessel, aircraft or truck.

affectedDistanceMeasure.description: The affected distance over which this calculated emission is measured.

pollutionMeasure.description: A measure of the pollution calculated for this emission.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of this calculated emission.

weightUnitWeightMeasure.description: A weight for which this calculated emission is measured.
